items.heading: In-Center Hemodialysis
steps: Ask the dialysis team to assess whether home dialysis is suitable.
Review support at home, training, space, and insurance coverage with the team.
Continue scheduled in-center dialysis until the team agrees on a new plan.

items.heading: Renal Diet and Food Access
steps: Go to Manna Food Pantry open Mondays 1:00-3:00 PM at 1230 S Millard Ave (1.56 miles away).

items.heading: Daily Weight and Blood Pressure Log
steps: Keep writing down your weight and blood pressure every day on paper, and bring the log to each dialysis session.

closing: Follow these steps and talk to your care team if you have questions.
